Assistant Professor, Center for Water Cycle, Marine Environment and Disaster Management, Kumamoto University

My research focuses on behavior modeling and planning in urban spaces. In particular, I study non-recurrent traffic under disasters and land use–transport interaction modeling. I am interested in how observation, theoretical modeling, and data science can be connected with urban design and planning in the real world.

I am currently an assistant professor at the Center for Water Cycle, Marine Environment and Disaster Management, Kumamoto University, Japan, where I work in Dr. Takuya Maruyama's research group.

Contact: masudasatoki[at]kumamoto-u.ac.jp
